page_title: Adoree — AI for Relationships, built for couples

sources.entry: Adoree - AI relationship assistant for couples where each partner talks privately, helping you both communicate without escalating. #freemium

summary.name: Adoree
summary.one_liner: Adoree is an AI relationship assistant for couples that talks with each partner privately and helps them understand each other better.
use_cases: Finding relationship patterns you have not noticed
Playing games together as a couple
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI chat assistant for relationships that can be used by one person or by both partners. Each partner talks to it privately, and the assistant is pitched as helping both sides be heard and understood, in contrast to general chatbots that only hear one person. Listed features include settling fights, splitting chores, planning date night, games for two, and teaching relationship skills. The page says it was built with psychology PhDs and cites 10M+ relationships analyzed, though these are marketing claims with no methodology given. A beta testimonial reports a 4.9 rating from 1,300 beta users.
notable: Each partner talks privately, so the assistant hears both sides
Built with psychology PhDs according to the page
Covers conflict resolution, chores, date planning and couples games in one tool
caveats: Page says it is free to try; full feature access and paid tiers are not described
Effectiveness claims (10M+ relationships, 4.9 rating from beta users) are self-reported marketing with no independent verification
